Needs changes before merge.

The code and the completed local checks have no blocking finding. The required heavy gate evidence is missing.

### What looks good

- The change checks each lead against its own ring before it changes the tangent.
- A mirrored lead must also pass the crossing check. The existing legal-room checks still apply.
- The tests cover climb and conventional cuts, with and without tabs. They check crossing, gouge, and full lead length.
- The new module has a provenance statement. The tests are in the motion crate. No dependency or process file changed.

### Results merged with main

I tested locally on macOS arm64 in `.claude/worktrees/review-3120`. The trial merge with upstream main `aa4c785dbd53715f1d811524dc99c688b9380cba` was clean.
The PR head was `8b17c42d7f804d8409bc1ad2ddf3e3699b675815`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 134 steps, including two builds and 132 test steps; 1,625 tests passed, zero failed, 64 ignored; 25.5 minutes |
| `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | PASS: release build and one light test; 2.5 minutes |
| Reached heavy lanes | NOT RUN: motion and app. The dry-run plan has 236 steps. The PR body also states that this gate was not run. |

The ignored tests in the quick gate are not evidence that the heavy lanes pass.

### Extra suites run

- `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-post --test vertical_arc_entry`: PASS, 3 tests.
- After both mutations were removed, `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-motion --test contour_tab_lead --test vertical_arc_entry`: PASS, 5 tests.
- The quick gate also ran motion `vertical_arc_entry`: PASS, 3 tests. The recorded CL comparisons passed.
- The diff changes no fixture, golden directory, or importer. The extra fixture and importer rules do not select more suites.

### Safety mutations

I repeated M2 and M3 locally. Each mutation changed only the review worktree. I restored the source before the final checks.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M2: remove the lead-out mirror | RED as expected: both new tests failed with `[[5, 14], [21, 30], [37, 46], [53, 62]]` |
| M3: remove the lead-in mirror | RED as expected: the conventional case failed with `[[3, 12], [19, 28], [35, 44], [51, 60]]`; the climb case passed |
| Restore the fix | GREEN: both new tests and all three motion arc-entry tests passed |

No golden moved. There is no changed golden to check line by line.

### Requested before merge

1. **Complete the reached heavy gate and record its results.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/lead_seam.rs:45` changes contour motion. The heavy plan reaches every heavy target in motion and app. The PR body's “Not exercised” section says this gate was not run. [Current upstream AGENTS.md, lines 628–636](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/aa4c785dbd53715f1d811524dc99c688b9380cba/AGENTS.md#L628-L636) requires the author to run the reached lanes on the final head before readiness. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` locally. Resolve any failures. Add the lane results to the PR body. Keep the PR as a draft until this requirement is met.

### Notes

The original QA project was not opened. The new tests reconstruct its plate and operation in the motion crate.
The PR changes no UI file, so before/after screenshots are not required for this diff.
